note: calibration /ddo run on prompt-caching.llms/llms-full.txt (see session record): voice-rephrase and meta-artifact-cleanup are structurally invalid for rights:extractive packs (would corrupt quotes / strip the required provenance banner); Pass 10.5 external verification is redundant busywork since every unit already carries a source URL, downgraded to medium (cheap citation-presence check only, no re-derivation); bracket-balance heuristic false-positived 3/3 times on ellipsis-truncated excerpts, a structural feature of budget-truncated extractive units, not corruption.

repo-wide scan (365 pages, 0.11s, zero model tokens) found: prompt-caching.json has facets:[] despite its source pack (outputs/llms-concepts/prompt-caching.llms/) carrying 176 units across 11 facets -- a real build/sync bug (major, confirmed real); 4 pages carry the exact same (text,source) fact duplicated across two differently-titled facets (medium, confirmed real via manual cross-facet check) -- a classification-boundary bug in gen_concepts.py/build_concept_packs.py worth fixing upstream, not per-page.

CORRECTS the prior calibration row's diagnosis. (1) facets_nonempty on prompt-caching.json was not a one-page sync gap: gen_concepts.py's FACT_RE matched only '- [passage]' because it was written against heart.llms, the abstractor's own eval fixture, which is 100% passage units. Real packs are 26% definition/parameter/snippet/fact/concept/problem/idea/actionable, so 1068 of 4072 units were silently dropped repo-wide and prompt-caching (0% passage) rendered blank. Fixed by accepting any [kind] and making text greedy so source binds to the LAST em-dash separator (titled and snippet lines carry more than one). Recovered +1387 facts across 14 pages. (2) The cross-facet duplicates were NOT a classification-boundary bug as first recorded: '## Disagreements' intentionally re-shows conflicting units side by side under '### <conflict-id>'. The real defect is that the classifier emits SINGLE-member conflict groups (tagging a unit as contentious rather than pairing clashing sources), which render as an unexplained duplicate of a fact from its own facet; concept_abstract.py also appended keep:false units to conflicts before the keep filter, so dropped content could resurface. Guarded in concept_abstract.py (>=2 surviving members) and again at the render layer for packs built before the fix. (3) Recovering snippet units exposed a third class: distinct code blocks truncate to the same fence+first-line text under one anchor, so identical (text,source) facts render as repeated bullets -- deduped in both generators. Scan went 8 flags -> 3, all 3 remaining being the known bracket_balance_heuristic noise. 4 regression tests added; 171 site + 286 hub tests green; ruff clean.
